newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Coffee due down, analysts see fall.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Coffee due down, analysts see fall.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA40
Coffee is likely to head lower, with $1,700 as its next target, analysts said.
Traders called it to open $30 down on numbers, "but we're looking for 15 max, at least initially," one said.
"It's much easier for it to go down, rather than up," Elli Gifford, an independent technical analyst, said. "1,700 is a reasonable aim," she said.
If coffee were to move higher, and clear 1,785, it would face resistance from 1,800 all the way up to 1,850, she said.
New York coffee futures ended mainly lower in thin trading on Monday, pressured by local and light speculative selling, dealers said.
Brazil's coffee regions face no risk of damaging cold in the next five to seven days, with polar air masses all passing to the south of the country, local meteorologists Somar said on Monday
